STYLE OF CAUSE: Nguyen v. Ontario (Attorney General)
CITATION: 2023 ONCA 210
COURT: Court of Appeal for Ontario
DOCKET: C69123
DATE: 2023-04-11

I. INTRODUCTION
[1] The appellant challenges the constitutionality of section 12 of the impugned regulation.

II. ANALYSIS
A. Standard of Review
[2] Questions involving the interpretation of the Charter are reviewed on a standard of correctness.
B. Section 12 of the Regulation
[3] Section 12 imposes a mandatory minimum condition that applies without regard to individual circumstances.
[4] Such a provision is capable of producing grossly disproportionate outcomes in a reasonable hypothetical case.
C. Section 1 Justification
[5] The Crown did not lead sufficient evidence to justify the infringement as a reasonable limit under section 1.

III. DISPOSITION
[6] The appeal is allowed and the regulation is declared of no force or effect.
